question: Which of the following days is celebrated as International Non-Violence Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2nd October**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **International Non-Violence Day** is celebrated on **2nd October** each year.
 
• This day marks the birth anniversary of **Mahatma Gandhi**, a key figure in the Indian independence movement and a global icon of peace and non-violence.
